name: Folha do STDB
query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.employee_name) AS SEQ_NO,
    DATE_FORMAT(ss.posting_date, '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS VALUE_DATE,
    CONCAT('Salario ', ELT(MONTH(ss.posting_date),
        'Janeiro','Fevereiro','Março','Abril','Maio','Junho',
        'Julho','Agosto','Setembro','Outubro','Novembro','Dezembro'
    )) AS REFERENCE,
    ss.employee_name AS DESTINATION_NAME,
    '' AS DESTINATION_SORT_CODE,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(e.nib, ' ', ''), '-', '') AS DESTINATION_ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
    ss.net_pay AS AMOUNT,
    ss.currency AS CURRENCY,
    '' AS DESTINATION_EMAIL
FROM
    `tabSalary Slip` ss
INNER JOIN
    `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = ss.employee
WHERE
    ss.docstatus = 1
    AND MONTH(ss.posting_date) = %(month)s
    AND YEAR(ss.posting_date) = %(year)s
ORDER BY
    ss.employee_name ASC
